purpose: Material moodboards only; initial and refinement prompts

prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: editorial material moodboard for identity research, NOT a logo master and NOT an app mockup. Landscape composition, overhead macro photography and restrained ink-study illustration on a continuous flat warm uncoated paper background #f4f2ed, black ink #111110 and graphite #5c5a55. Rich visible paper grain only in this moodboard, soft daylight, plenty of negative space, sophisticated working notebook of a real independent fitness coach. No screen, phone, interface, brand, logo, caption, slogan, emojis, dumbbells, trophies, flame, tape, stickers, collage scraps, crumpled paper, decorative blue fields, robots, AI imagery. Blue #2b48d6 only in marks physically made by the coach. Show material and stroke character, do not imply exact usable vector assets. Three quiet adjacent studies on the same sheet: fine blue ballpoint check beside a small handwritten set count; black fine nib pen with a subtly pressure-varying blue underline beneath a number; a thicker semi-opaque blue felt-tip check. A restrained handwritten note in Russian reads exactly «держи спину». Show pen tips and close-up ink edges, no finished logo. The human coach's record and care are the subject.

refinement.prompt: Remove every human figure, anatomy drawing, barbell, equipment sketch and botanical drawing. Replace those drawings with untouched warm paper. Keep only the pens, small handwritten recording numbers, blue check marks, blue stroke tests and Russian handwritten «держи спину». This board must study paper and ink only. Keep the same paper and material realism, no new objects.
